events.title: Kickstarter campaign opens
events.summary: Avegant launched the Glyph Kickstarter campaign before I joined the company.
events.date_basis: Company campaign launch date, distinct from the February 21 funding close.

events.title: Kickstarter funding closes
events.summary: The Glyph Kickstarter campaign closed its funding period.
events.date_basis: Dated company creator update; a funding milestone, not product delivery.

events.title: An established product architecture
events.summary: A product design brief already described the headwear geometry, adjustment, folding, eye spacing and focus adjustments. This was part of the product context I inherited.
events.date_basis: June 16 date printed on the brief cover; June 17 filename is not substituted. Later January 2015 material is excluded from this marker.

events.title: The original delivery estimate
events.summary: The hardware reward tiers originally estimated delivery in December 2014.
events.date_basis: Month-precision estimate attached to the original hardware rewards; no exact day is established.

events.title: Joining Avegant
events.summary: I joined Avegant as a Senior Mechanical Engineer to help get Glyph into production. Richard Lane recommended me to Joerg Tewes. That led to an introduction to Allan Evans.
events.date_basis: Actual start date from Erik’s recollection; correspondence corroborates the intended date, rather than independently proving attendance.

events.title: Drawing notes released
events.summary: The revision history records the first release of the CAD drawing-notes document under my name.
events.date_basis: August 10 document-release entry in the revision history. Broader rollout is not assigned this date.

events.title: Physical headstrap alternatives
events.summary: A dated concept deck records three physical headstrap mockups.
events.date_basis: Date printed on the concept-deck cover; it dates the documented mockups, not final selection.

events.title: Refining the reliability methods
events.summary: My edited reliability plan addressed fixtures, actuation ranges, check intervals and environmental and drop-test methods, while asking colleagues to resolve missing conditions. I was revising Frank Jiang’s earlier plan and seeking input from Jansen and Geoff.
events.date_basis: August 25 edited-file identity; displayed at month precision with no exact-day plot coordinate. Earlier Frank Jiang revisions remain separate.

events.title: Cosmetic criteria and inspection requirements
events.summary: I revised the general cosmetic and durability specification, adding cosmetic criteria and reorganizing the requirements for inspection, color measurement and supplier test reports. Billy Fung had developed the initial requirements.
events.date_basis: Native update-history row for revision 2; revision 1 dated 2015-07-24.

events.title: Coordinating supplier changes
events.summary: The EVT2 change tracker separated optics, headset and miscellaneous work and required supplier feasibility, cost and timing information followed by Avegant approval before tool changes.
events.date_basis: Tracker/deck date.

events.title: Ear-cover drawings revised
events.summary: Revision 7 ear-cover drawings recorded changes following the supplier reviews of ribs, shutoff draft and tool clearances.
events.date_basis: September 30 revision 7 entries only; earlier supplier agreement is background, not redated.

events.title: Custom engraving test instructions
events.summary: I specified a custom-engraving test batch and instructed the supplier to exclude the layout outline from the engraved artwork.
events.date_basis: October 14 native slide date for the engraving request only; November 10 follow-up is excluded from this marker.

events.title: Liner material and marking revised
events.summary: The liner drawings removed an end-flange extension, changed the second-shot material and adjusted marking height. Misha Young is credited for these revisions.
events.date_basis: November 20 drawing revisions only; November 18 clip/flange changes remain earlier supporting context.

events.title: Inspection dimensions added
events.summary: I added inspection and critical-to-function dimensions to ear-cover and button-backer drawings without changing their 3D geometry.
events.date_basis: Revision-table date on both December 3 and December 4 path instances; package dates are not new design-event dates.

events.title: Button-backer samples measured
events.summary: Received button-backer samples were checked against the specified contact feature following the earlier button-feel investigation and drawing change.
events.date_basis: November 30 received-sample presentation/annotations only; November 9 investigation and November 12 revision are earlier actions.

events.title: Liner carrier drawings updated
events.summary: The liner carrier drawings incorporated Voke’s design-for-manufacture feedback. Misha Young and I are separately credited on the two drawings.
events.date_basis: Revision 3 dates in December 8 exported drawing instances.

events.title: Shipping announced
events.summary: Avegant announced that Glyph shipping was beginning, with the first mailing expected late that week.
events.date_basis: Dated company creator update; the first mailing was still expected.

events.title: Tracking notices during the ramp
events.summary: Avegant reported sending more than 200 tracking numbers while the production line remained below full rate.
events.date_basis: Dated company creator update; tracking notices are distinct from customer receipts.

events.title: Checking gloss variation
events.summary: Variation among production units prompted a request for matched-batch parts and quantified finish measurements.
events.date_basis: February 10 request slide date only; later workbook date is not treated as the test date.

events.title: About 1,000 units reportedly shipped
events.summary: Avegant reported about 1,000 Glyph units shipped while international certification and order sequencing were still active.
events.date_basis: Dated company creator update; quantity remains approximate and company-reported.

events.title: Earpad gripper prototypes requested
events.summary: A dated presentation requested six earpad gripper prototypes.
events.date_basis: March 31 date inside the prototype-request presentation; March 8 filename is not used. The separate grip workbook is undated.

events.title: Mechanical work continues through the ramp
events.summary: My weekly update still had cable-abrasion changes in validation, liner tooling and clamp-force work open, and sample and validation work underway with another cable supplier.
events.date_basis: Date of the weekly worksheet. Future target dates in its other columns are not completed event dates.

events.title: Kickstarter deployment reported complete
events.summary: Avegant reported that the Kickstarter units were fully deployed.
events.date_basis: Dated company creator update; deployment wording is not independently verified receipt or engineering closure.

events.title: A further clamp-force comparison
events.summary: A build-and-test matrix separated liner material, paint state and spring diameter, and required the parts and assembled units to be identified. The record does not identify a selected production configuration.
events.date_basis: August 17 matrix/presentation date only. August 16 stock feedback is separately attributed context.

events.title: A liner tool change approved
events.summary: A response to the supplier’s liner-tool proposal records approval of a specific gate-area modification.
events.date_basis: Approved overlay preserved in the August 25 response file; public display stays at month precision without an occurrence-day coordinate. August 24 diagnostic request is separate.

events.title: Leaving Avegant
events.summary: I left after eighteen months at Avegant. I remember Chris Westra’s farewell as personal recognition of the work.
events.date_basis: Exact employment end date supplied by Erik on October3,2026; personal recollection, not inferred from the final technical record.
